basics.name: ZJ Lin
basics.label: Senior Blockchain Engineer & Consultant
basics.summary: Senior blockchain engineer specializing in Go, Solidity, DeFi infrastructure, and asset tokenization. Experienced in protocol integrations, transaction safety, and cross-functional technical leadership.

work.summary: Building production DeFi execution infrastructure in Go and Solidity.
highlights: Built atomic Curve peg-arbitrage systems using own-capital and Morpho flash-loan funding.
Ported Curve TwoCrypto and vault-minting math to byte-exact Go implementations with differential, fuzz, and EVM execution testing.
Integrated Curve and Stake DAO strategies and hardened execution with minimum-output checks, typed reverts, telemetry, and circuit breakers.

work.summary: Designing smart-contract frameworks and leading delivery for asset tokenization and automated market systems.
highlights: Designed Ethereum frameworks for real-world-asset tokenization and on-chain asset management.
Led a six-person cross-functional team building a Uniswap V2/V3 arbitrage system.
Established Solidity standards, security practices, and engineering workflows.

work.summary: Developed APIs and blockchain-backed fintech integrations.
highlights: Built REST APIs, NFT-based certificates of authenticity, identity verification, and financial-product smart-contract prototypes.

work.summary: Built smart-contract infrastructure for Layer 2 ecosystems.
highlights: Developed deterministic deployment factories, role-based access controls, validator staking contracts, and ERC-20 native-token support.
